description: Bundled type-spec for the two trivial, logic-free read-only queries over _CANCEL_REGISTRY. Grouped in one file since both are single-line lock-guarded lookups with no independent branching worth documenting separately.
signature:
def is_running(run_id: str) -> bool: ...

def active_run_ids() -> list[str]: ...
docstring:
is_running: True iff run_id has a live worker registered in this process right now (i.e. is a key in _CANCEL_REGISTRY). Used by the UI to decide whether to show Cancel vs Resume for a given run, and by resume_run to reject a resume against an already-running run.

active_run_ids: All run_ids with a live worker in this process, in no particular order. Used by the UI's 'Start disabled while a run is active' rule (ADR-001 supports only one writer) and by reconcile_orphaned_runs to know which 'running'-status rows in the database are NOT actually orphaned.

Both read _CANCEL_REGISTRY under its lock and return a plain snapshot; neither blocks on anything beyond acquiring that lock briefly.
postconditions: is_running(run_id) == (run_id in active_run_ids()) for every run_id, always
The returned list from active_run_ids() is a snapshot; mutating it does not affect the registry

edge_cases.input: No run has ever been started in this process
Called concurrently with a worker's finally block removing its own entry
edge_cases.expected_behavior: returns either the pre- or post-removal snapshot, never a torn/partial read, since access is lock-guarded

unit_tests.name: test_is_running_true_for_registered_run
unit_tests.description: After start_pipeline_async registers a run, is_running returns True for it.

unit_tests.name: test_is_running_false_for_unregistered_run
unit_tests.description: An unstarted or finished run_id returns False.

unit_tests.name: test_active_run_ids_reflects_registry_snapshot
unit_tests.description: With two live workers registered, active_run_ids() returns both ids and no others.
unit_tests.expected: a list containing exactly the two registered run_ids

unit_tests.name: test_consistency_between_both_functions
unit_tests.description: For a set of run_ids in mixed states, is_running(rid) matches (rid in active_run_ids()) for every rid.
